name: Legato Hum
description: Hum a smooth unbroken line beside a partner so their soul work flows without a gap.

name: Timbre Read
description: Read the timbre of a partner's soul to learn the fine grain of their strength and weakness.

name: Sustain Guard
description: Sustain a single held note round the user that does not break under a hostile soul blow.

name: Paired Crescendo
description: Raise the volume of a pair of souls together in one steady crescendo that lifts the strength of both.

name: Overtone Cleansing
description: Draw the overtones of a clean partner's soul over a stained one until the stain thins and goes.

name: Vibrato Mend
description: Shake a gentle vibrato through a partner's strained soul so the knots in it loosen and release.

name: Pillar Chord
description: Stand a pillar of sustained chord under a partner so their soul work cannot be shaken from its place.

name: Cantor's Recall
description: Recall a partner's soul to the body with a long cantor's call within the short window.

name: Octave Lift
description: Lift a partner's soul an octave above its usual pitch so that all their techniques gain depth and reach.

name: Pillar Song
description: Sing the paired song of the school whose reach and strength follow the master's soul and lift each partner to a peak.

name: Staccato Count
description: Tap short sharp notes through a company and count the answers to learn who stands ready.

name: Round Lend
description: Start a round and hand the next line to an ally so their soul takes up the tune with ease.

name: Tremolo Screen
description: Shake a fast tremolo before the user so that a hostile soul tone loses its aim in the blur.

name: Company Crescendo
description: Raise the whole company in one crescendo so the soul work of every member swells with the next beat.

name: Dissonance Purge
description: Purge a stuck dissonance from an ally's soul by sounding its resolving note until the clash falls out.

name: Antiphon Reply
description: Answer the master's phrase with the echo of the company so each soul strike lands twice in turn.

name: Soothing Tremolo
description: Pass a soft slow tremolo over an ally's shaken soul until the shaking eases and the tone is firm.

name: Twin-Voiced Round
description: Run a round in twin voices through the company so that every ally takes strength from the one beside.

name: Antiphon Rekindle
description: Answer the silence of a fallen ally's soul with the antiphon until it replies within the short window.

name: Grand Antiphon
description: Sing the grand antiphon in which the whole company answers the master and every soul reaches full strength.

name: Voiced Company
description: Give every ally in the company a second voice whose strength follows the soul of the master.

name: Skyward Hum
description: Hum a note that rises toward the open sky and draw an ally's soul work up with it.

name: High Listening
description: Listen from the top of a clear note and mark every soul tone below it.

name: Highsound Ward
description: Hold a bright high ward over the user that rings a hostile soul note away from the mind.

name: Choral Swell
description: Swell the voices of an allied host in a choral line until the host works as a single soul.

name: Choral Cleansing
description: Cleanse a stained soul with the whole choir singing the clean tone of the Core.

name: Choral Mending
description: Sing a choral mending that closes the wounds in several allied souls at once.

name: Crown Sustain
description: Sustain the crowning tone of the choir so that every soul beneath it works at a higher pitch.

name: Dawn Peal
description: Peal a rising dawn note over a fallen ally whose soul has gone dark and bring it back in time.

name: Choral Zenith
description: Bring the choir to its zenith so that every soul in the host is held at the top of its power.

name: Choir Crown
description: Crown the host with a choir whose depth follows the formed Core of its master and holds every soul at its peak.

name: Sworn Legato
description: Sing a sworn smooth line beside an ally so that their soul work holds to its promise without a break.

name: Gale Tally
description: Let a gust of tone sweep the field and tally the soul tones it brings back.

name: Gale Hush
description: Blow a hush of tone round the user that smothers the edge of a hostile soul note.

name: Gust Crescendo
description: Build the choir to a gust of sound that drives every ally's soul technique harder.

name: Oath Unbinding
description: Sing the unbinding line of the oath over an ally and loosen the hostile tone that holds their soul.

name: Gale Balm
description: Pour a warm gale of tone over a hurt ally and let it knit the soul where the wind touches.

name: Wind-Sworn Round
description: Pass a sworn round from voice to voice on the wind until the choir sounds as one soul.

name: Vow Awakening
description: Sing the vow of the choir over a fallen comrade to wake their soul within the short window.

name: Oath Octave
description: Raise the whole choir an octave on the oath so that every soul rings high and holds firm.

name: Vow Chorale
description: Sing the vow chorale of the school whose strength follows the master's soul and leaves no comrade alone.

name: Held Pitch
description: Hold one pitch beside an ally until their soul technique settles on it and stays.

name: Pitch Gauge
description: Measure how far an ally's soul has strayed from the held pitch of the company.

name: Sustained Hush
description: Sustain a long hush that presses on a hostile soul tone until it gives out.

name: Fermata Lift
description: Hold the note past its time so every ally's soul work is lifted and kept aloft.

name: Fermata Release
description: Hold the release of the note over an ally until the hostile tone has drained out of them.

name: Fermata Mending
description: Hold a restful note over a worn ally long enough for the soul to fill and settle.

name: Silenced Fermata
description: Hold a foe's soul note until it dies so that their technique cannot sound again for a moment.

name: Unwavering Fermata
description: Hold the note without waver across the whole company so that no soul drops out of the chord.

name: Fermata Recall
description: Hold the recalling note over a fallen ally until their soul answers within the short window.

name: Endless Fermata
description: Hold the note without end so that the whole company works in unbroken harmony.

name: Unbroken Hold
description: Hold the school note over the company with a length and strength set by the soul of the master.

name: Open Cantor
description: Cantor a plain line beside an ally so that their soul work finds its place in the open.

name: Wind Tuning
description: Sound a tuning tone on the wind and read the answers of every soul in range.

name: Wind Hush
description: Hush the wind about the user to a breath so a hostile soul tone loses its carrying force.

name: Open Wind Balm
description: Let the open wind carry a healing note over a worn ally until the soul has its depth back.

name: Oath Crescendo
description: Swell the oath in the open wind so every ally's soul technique rises with it.

name: Oath Cleansing
description: Sing the cleansing verse of the oath until the stain on a comrade's soul is blown clean.

name: Gale Antiphon
description: Pass a soul strike down the line of allies on the gale so each blow follows the last.

name: Wind Lullaby
description: Sing a drowsy line on the wind that dulls the soul work of foes until they falter.

name: Sworn Diapason
description: Sound the sworn diapason through the company so that every soul reaches the full span of its power.

name: Sworn Recall
description: Sing the sworn recall over a fallen comrade to bring the soul back within the short window.

name: Wind Octave
description: Raise the oath an octave on the wind so that the company's souls ring clear across the whole field.

name: Open Wind Oath
description: Sing the school oath beneath the open wind with a strength set by the formed Core of the master.
